text:
emma: Kicking off eu-west deploy window for v2.14.3 — canary 10% for 15m. Change window 22:00-00:00 CET. Changelog: https://redwood.internal/rel/2.14.3

deploy-bot: canary started -> 10% traffic to v2.14.3 (instances: 6)

raj: seeing p95 climb in canary
raj: p95: 320ms (+60ms vs baseline)
raj: 5xx rate up from 0.3% -> 1.4% over last 2m

mika: checked traces — tail latency concentrated on attention kernel calls, looks like new fused-kernel path
mika: also noticing more KV cache misses in canary

sara: @emma can we pause traffic? error budget for canary path under threshold
sara: runbook: https://go/runbooks/deploy-slo-guard

ops-bot: ALERT: canary error_budget <= 45% (window=5m). Triggering recommended action: PAUSE_CANARY

lee: pausing canary now, scaling canary pool to 0
lee: command: `deployctl pause-canary --service=inference --tag=v2.14.3`

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% traffic. Autoscale: canary_instances -> 0. Notifying deploy channel.

mika: propose fast rollback to v2.14.2 for eu-west only, then investigate kernel regression
mika: suggested routing pin command:
```
routingctl pin --service=inference --region=eu-west --version=v2.14.2 --pct=100 --reason="slo-spike-2026-03-20"
```

emma: agree. executing rollback and opening incident ticket
emma: `deployctl rollback --service=inference --to v2.14.2 --region=eu-west --reason="canary-slo-spike"`

deploy-bot: Rollback started -> target v2.14.2 (eu-west). Rolling back 6 instances.

ops-bot: POST-CHANGE CHECK: p95 back to 265ms, 5xx -> 0.35% (2m after rollback)

raj: confirming dashboards look stable. will capture traces and attach to ticket.
raj: quick trace link: https://sketch.trace/xyz

emma: filing follow-up: action_items: (1) revert fused-kernel change in build pipeline (2) add perf matrics to preflight (3) postmortem
emma: ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123

sara: thanks all. tagging product & infra for visibility :eyes:

lee: leaving the deploy window closed for now. re-open after regression fix and preflight

mika: will start bisect on kernel change, will update ticket with findings

emma: good work. closing thread — keep reactions on ticket for follow-up. :thumbsup:
